title: Decisions API - AI ke chhote faisle, 10x fast
content:
Ek AI API jisme output ka paisa hi nahi lagta.
Only input. Ten cents per million tokens.
OpenAI ne kal Decisions API ko generally available kar diya.
It is built with GPT-6 Luna.
Aur iska kaam ek hi hai: chhote, fixed answer wale decisions lena, bahut fast.
Ab decision ka matlab kya hai?
Socho aapke app mein roz hazaaron chhote sawaal aate hain.
Ye message complaint hai ya query? Ye lead hot hai ya cold? Ye ticket kis team ko jaana chahiye?
Each one is simple. But at scale, the cost and the waiting time add up.
OpenAI ke hisaab se ye GPT-6 Luna ko normal Responses API se use karne se up to ten times faster hai.
Ek request mein aap four hundred tak sawaal pooch sakte ho, jo pehle ki limit ka double hai.
Aur pricing? Ten cents per million input tokens, cached input sirf one cent, aur output tokens ka koi charge nahi.
Ab asli kaam ki baat. Iska use kaise karein?
Step ONE. Apne business ya project ka ek repeat decision chuno.
Maan lo aapke paas ek coaching institute hai, aur Instagram pe roz sau DMs aate hain.
Step TWO. Answers fix karo. Admission, fees, spam, ya other.
Bounded answers is the whole point. Open ended mat chhodo.
Step THREE. Pehle pachaas real examples pe test karo, Decisions Playground mein.
Check how many it gets right before you trust it.
Phir har category ko sahi insaan ya auto reply pe route karo.
Mera take simple hai... har kaam ke liye sabse bada model use karna paisa jalana hai.
Small decisions should go to a fast, cheap system. Bade model ko sirf mushkil kaam do.
Yahi skill companies aur clients dono dhoondh rahe hain.
Docs ka link chahiye? Comment DECIDE and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
